definitions.rationale: Expands the named solutionBody proof term into the translated Python statement sequence; this is a macro-style definition of the program body.
definitions.text:
rule solutionBody =>
        If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<", Int(10))),
          Return(
            TupleExpr(
              BinOp("//", Name("n"), Int(2)),
              BinOp("//", BinOp("+", Name("n"), Int(1)), Int(2)))),
          .Stmts)
        If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<", Int(100))),
          Assign(Name("two_digit"), BinOp("//", Name("n"), Int(11)))
          Return(
            TupleExpr(
              BinOp("+", Int(4),
                BinOp("//", Name("two_digit"), Int(2))),
              BinOp("+", Int(5),
                BinOp("//",
                  BinOp("+", Name("two_digit"), Int(1)),
                  Int(2))))),
          .Stmts)
        If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("==", Int(1000))),
          Return(TupleExpr(Int(48), Int(60))),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(Name("hundreds"),
          BinOp("//", Name("n"), Int(100)))
        Assign(Name("current_block"),
          BinOp("+",
            BinOp("//",
              BinOp("-",
                BinOp("%", Name("n"), Int(100)),
                Name("hundreds")),
              Int(10)),
            Int(1)))
        Assign(Name("even"),
          BinOp("+", Int(8),
            BinOp("*", Int(10),
              BinOp("//",
                BinOp("-", Name("hundreds"), Int(1)),
                Int(2)))))
        Assign(Name("odd"),
          BinOp("+", Int(10),
            BinOp("*", Int(10),
              BinOp("//", Name("hundreds"), Int(2)))))
        If(
          Compare(
            BinOp("%", Name("hundreds"), Int(2)),
            CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
          AugAssign(Name("even"), "+", Name("current_block")),
          AugAssign(Name("odd"), "+", Name("current_block")))
        Return(TupleExpr(Name("even"), Name("odd")))

definitions.rationale: Defines solutionModule as the module AST containing the target function and the previously defined solutionBody.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule =>
    Module(
      FuncDef(
        "even_odd_palindrome",
        Params("n"),
        solutionBody))

definitions.rationale: Defines the leadingDigit arithmetic summary used by the three-digit palindrome-count formulas.
Defines currentBlock, the arithmetic summary counting eligible palindromes in the current three-digit leading-digit block.
Defines the even-palindrome count for the one-digit input region.
definitions.text:
rule evenPalindromes(N:Int) => N /Int 2
    requires 1 <=Int N andBool N <Int 10

definitions.rationale: Defines the even-palindrome count for the two-digit input region.
definitions.text:
rule evenPalindromes(N:Int) => 4 +Int (N /Int 11) /Int 2
    requires 10 <=Int N andBool N <Int 100

definitions.rationale: Defines the even-palindrome count for the three-digit input region using leadingDigit and currentBlock.
definitions.text:
rule evenPalindromes(N:Int) =>
      8
      +Int 10 *Int ((leadingDigit(N) -Int 1) /Int 2)
      +Int (#if leadingDigit(N) %Int 2 ==Int 0
            #then currentBlock(N) #else 0 #fi)
    requires 100 <=Int N andBool N <Int 1000

definitions.rationale: Defines the even-palindrome count at the upper-bound input 1000.
Defines the odd-palindrome count for the one-digit input region.
definitions.text:
rule oddPalindromes(N:Int) => (N +Int 1) /Int 2
    requires 1 <=Int N andBool N <Int 10

definitions.rationale: Defines the odd-palindrome count for the two-digit input region.
definitions.text:
rule oddPalindromes(N:Int) =>
      5 +Int ((N /Int 11) +Int 1) /Int 2
    requires 10 <=Int N andBool N <Int 100

definitions.rationale: Defines the odd-palindrome count for the three-digit input region using leadingDigit and currentBlock.
definitions.text:
rule oddPalindromes(N:Int) =>
      10
      +Int 10 *Int (leadingDigit(N) /Int 2)
      +Int (#if leadingDigit(N) %Int 2 ==Int 1
            #then currentBlock(N) #else 0 #fi)
    requires 100 <=Int N andBool N <Int 1000
